SELECT operate_admin_log.id, admin_user.login_code, admin_user.login_name, operate_admin_log.module, operate_admin_log.title, operate_admin_log.resource, operate_admin_log.ip, operate_admin_log.type, operate_admin_log.exception, operate_admin_log.create_time FROM operate_admin_log LEFT JOIN admin_user ON operate_admin_log.user_id = admin_user.id
operate_admin_log.is_delete = 0 AND operate_admin_log.event_type = 'AUTHENTICATION'
AND operate_admin_log.create_time >= #{req.startTime}
AND operate_admin_log.create_time <= #{req.endTime}
AND admin_user.login_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.loginCode}, '%')
AND admin_user.login_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.loginName}, '%')
AND operate_admin_log.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.title}, '%')
ORDER BY operate_admin_log.id DESC
